faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything players and owners ask the most.

items.a: Yes. The launcher and the directory are free. You pay nothing to join a server.
Yes. The launcher never sees your password: you sign in on the official Microsoft page. Mods come from CurseForge and Modrinth.

items.q: How much space does it take?
items.a: About 300 MB for the launcher, then each modpack (often 1 to 3 GB). The launcher tells you before downloading.

items.q: Windows shows a blue screen during install, what do I do?
items.a: Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”. Windows shows this screen for programs that don't have a code-signing certificate yet. It does not mean the launcher is dangerous.

items.q: Does it work on Mac or Linux?
items.a: Not yet: the launcher is for Windows for now.

items.q: Do I need a Minecraft account?
items.a: Yes. You need Minecraft Java Edition, bought, with your Microsoft account. The launcher does not let you play without it.

items.q: Can I play with Minecraft Bedrock (console, phone)?
items.a: No, the launcher runs Minecraft Java Edition.

items.q: Microsoft sign-in doesn't work, what do I do?
items.a: Close the launcher, reopen it and try again. If it is still stuck, write to us from the Contact page.

items.q: Do I have to install mods myself?
items.a: No. When you click “Open in the launcher”, it installs the right Minecraft version, the modpack and its mods on its own.

items.q: Where do the mods come from?
items.a: From CurseForge and Modrinth, the two big Minecraft mod sites.

items.q: How do I join a server?
items.a: Pick a server in the directory, then click “Open in the launcher”. The launcher prepares everything and connects you.

items.q: Why isn't the server address shown?
items.a: On purpose: the launcher connects you with the right mods. It avoids version errors.

items.q: What does “Tested in the launcher” mean?
items.a: That the launcher recently installed and started this server successfully. It is a test, not a guarantee.

items.q: How do I report a server?
items.a: In the launcher, on the server page, use the “Report” button. The team looks at every report.

items.q: How do I add my server?
items.a: Sign in, go to “My servers” then “Create my page”. Your page shows in the directory once published.

items.q: Can I pay to rank higher?
items.a: No. No ranking is paid. Anything promoted for money is marked “Sponsored” and kept apart from the ranking.

items.q: How do I customise my page?
items.a: In your area, open “My page”: colour, wallpaper, tags, languages, sections. The preview updates live.

worlds.fair: Supporter also helps pay for the site. No in-game advantage, no paid ranking.
